Hi Team, I wanted to share an important observation regarding our current advertising strategy. Since Sindhwear is a niche brand specifically built around Sindhi culture and identity, I am trying to understand why we are currently targeting Pan India audiences instead of focusing primarily on Sindhi-dense regions and communities. Most of our designs contain Sindhi words, cultural references, traditions, and sentiments that are meaningful mainly to Sindhis. People from other communities may not understand these references, making it less likely for them to engage with or purchase the products. Showing ads to audiences who have no connection with Sindhi culture could result in unnecessary ad spend and lower conversion rates. Additionally, the creatives currently being used do not strongly communicate the Sindhi cultural aspect of the brand. At first glance, they appear similar to generic quote-based T-shirts rather than a dedicated Sindhi cultural apparel brand. The creatives should clearly highlight Sindhi identity, culture, language, festivals, traditions, and community pride so that the right audience instantly connects with the brand. My suggestions: 1. Focus initial campaigns on Sindhi-dense cities and regions such as Ulhasnagar, Ahmedabad, Adipur-Gandhidham, Pune, Mumbai, Indore, Bhopal, Jaipur, Hyderabad, and other areas with a significant Sindhi population. 2. Target Sindhi community groups, interests, cultural organizations, and related audiences. 3. Use creatives that clearly showcase the Sindhi cultural connection rather than generic T-shirt visuals. 4. Build awareness within the Sindhi community first before expanding to broader audiences. I would appreciate your thoughts on the current targeting strategy and how we can better align the campaigns with the brand's niche audience. Thanks.
